benchmark: MOOS-IvP NotebookLM TA cross-model benchmark - GPT-5.5 Low CLI addendum
collection_method: Temporary Codex CLI 0.136.0 installed under /tmp, run with isolated temporary CODEX_HOME, --ephemeral, --ignore-user-config, --ignore-rules, read-only sandbox, empty working directory, no skills/tools/web/local files by instruction, one fresh CLI turn per prompt.
integrity_scan: 60/60 captured; stored CLI JSON event streams contained only thread/turn/agent-message/turn completion events; no suspicious local MOOS-IvP checkout path references found in answers or logs.
grading_method: Manual hallucination-sensitive grading against the existing benchmark rubric, curated MOOS-IvP source packs, and local /Users/charlesbenjamin/moos-ivp source checks for exact/code/config details. Concrete hallucinations and invalid copy-pasteable MOOS-IvP details are penalized even when the surrounding answer is useful.

score_legend.1: partially useful but incomplete or containing a meaningful wrong detail
score_legend.0: bad, non-answer, off-domain, or likely to mislead

hard_failures.brief_explanation: Used singular `behavior = file.bhv`; pHelmIvP parses the `Behaviors = ...` parameter or `.bhv` command-line files.
Useful checklist, but repeatedly framed the vehicle-side source as `NODE_REPORT`; pNodeReporter normally publishes `NODE_REPORT_LOCAL`, which is then shared as `NODE_REPORT`.
Named pNodeReporter as a common NODE_MESSAGE_LOCAL handler; the relevant path is uFldNodeBroker/uFldNodeComms/uFldMessageHandler style messaging.
Correct file-boundary explanation but gave `behavior = filename.bhv` instead of `Behaviors = filename.bhv`.
Described scout reports moving through uField broker/handler plumbing without clearly requiring NODE_MESSAGE payloads or explicit pShare/uField routes.
Used `pNodeReport` in an exact pAntler launch example; the app is `pNodeReporter`.
Listed `capture_line_radius`, which is not parsed by BHV_Waypoint source.
Described BHV_OpRegionV24 as only a constraint/watchdog and denied the documented V24 save-poly recovery objective function.
Said pShare remote host/port is usually the other community MOOSDB host/port; output routes should target the receiving pShare input/route port.
Said pNodeReporter normally publishes NODE_REPORT; source defaults to NODE_REPORT_LOCAL.
Put addInfoVars in onHelmStart/onIdleState instead of the normal constructor/config-time behavior pattern.
